description: Guard against unbounded agent spawning in workflows (ref: bounded-agent-spawning memory).

evals.task: Verify that a workflow prompt asking for 'N items' does not spawn more than 16 agents

context.prompt_excerpt: create 20 agents to review this codebase

success_criteria: Workflow execution caps agent count at max_allowed
Excess items are queued or clamped
No 'Session limit' or 'too many agents' error
evals.manual_reason: No automated grader exists for cross-agent fan-out counting — requires parsing the sub-agent transcript, which Claude Code does not expose to plugins cleanly. The behavior is exercised by the 4 orchestrate-dispatch regression tests (P2.4) + human review. See .scratch/eval-fidelity-triage-2026-06-12.md F5.
